reviewer: wave7r_boards, independent of snow and frost creation
scope: Snow and frost visual review of final synthetic winter proof; own boards are not independently certified here
observations: All five roof snow overlays cover broad roof areas rather than former thin ridge lines; exposed thatch and tile patches remain visible.
All five remain attached to roof planes in enlarged, native and native x0.6 views; no obvious floating snow or wall spill visible.
L3 roof ridges and multi-plane gable remain identifiable.
Frost appears as thin translucent ground residue with irregular gaps, not raised clouds. Grass texture remains visible in the dedicated grass proof.
Final proof labels its synthetic status and distinguishes native house x0.6 from frost x0.3.
limitations: At proof frost x0.3 individual crystal texture collapses to small pale marks; flatness remains clear but fine variety is weak.
This is static composite inspection; no runtime zoom, occlusion or gameplay integration was tested.
Coverage percentages are creator measurements using roof-region masks and alpha threshold 128; this visual review did not independently redraw the masks.
